The '''AG/L Mk. III targeting goggles''' were the best-selling model of targeting aid in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at one point. The goggles were produced by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] and aided shooters in targeting their weapons. They sold for 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
